title: Repossession Assignment, Notice and Expense Schedule for Kestrel Advantage Balloon Accounts
content:
Recovery on a Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract uses one schedule per tier for the days past due before assignment, the notice of intent to sell, the agency, transport, condition report and storage expenses, and the hold on personal property.

| | Tier 5 | Tier 4 | Tier 3 | Tier 2 | Tier 1 | Tier 1+ |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Days past due before an account may be assigned for repossession (minimum) | 60 | 60 | 75 | 75 | 90 | 90 |
| Business days after repossession within which the notice of intent to sell is mailed | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 |
| Agency fee, involuntary recovery (USD) | 425.00 | 425.00 | 425.00 | 425.00 | 425.00 | 425.00 |
| Agency fee, voluntary surrender (USD) | 175.00 | 175.00 | 175.00 | 175.00 | 175.00 | 175.00 |
| Transport fee, involuntary recovery (USD) | 150.00 | 150.00 | 150.00 | 150.00 | 150.00 | 150.00 |
| Condition report fee, once per repossession (USD) | 75.00 | 75.00 | 75.00 | 75.00 | 75.00 | 75.00 |
| Storage charge per day beyond the free days (USD) | 20.00 | 20.00 | 20.00 | 20.00 | 20.00 | 20.00 |
| Storage days not charged after repossession | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 |
| Calendar days personal property is held before it may be disposed of | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 |

## Notes

- Only the assignment threshold differs by tier: 60 days on Tier 5 and Tier 4, 75 on Tier 3 and Tier 2, 90 on Tier 1 and Tier 1+.
- *Hypothetical illustration:* a vehicle stored 8 days with 3 free days carries 5 chargeable days at USD 20.00, USD 100.00.
